transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I guess things have just been a bit much lately. My father-in-law moved in with us recently, and... I don't know, ever since then I've been snapping at my wife over stupid little things around the house. 

I've been letting a lot of stuff slide, too. Just putting off jobs and paperwork I usually stay on top of. It's just... I can't seem to get my head quiet. Even if I go out to the workshop to get away, or... or try to get some fishing in. I just can't clear my head.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge lately?
I guess so. Yeah. Just... hard to settle down, you know? Like I said, I can't get my head quiet.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
Not really. No. I wouldn't say sad. Just... wound up, I guess.
Have you been avoiding any activities or places because of how you've been feeling lately?
No, I wouldn't say that. I still try to do my usual things, like going out to the workshop. I'm not really avoiding anywhere.
Have you had any episodes where you suddenly felt extremely frightened or panicked?
No. Not really. Nothing sudden like that. Just... what I said before, about being wound up. But no panic.
Have you been having any recurring thoughts that you can't seem to get out of your head?
No, I don't think so. Just... normal stuff, I guess. Nothing that gets stuck like that.
Do you find yourself repeating certain behaviors over and over?
No. I don't do anything like that.
Have you been feeling more tired than usual lately?
No... not really. Just the usual amount, I guess. I haven't really noticed being more tired.
How long have you been feeling wound up and unable to clear your head?
About five months. I guess it started... well, shortly after my father-in-law moved into our house.
Have you been having any thoughts that keep coming back to you, even when you try to think about something else?
No... I don't think so. Just regular thoughts, I guess. Nothing like that.
Do you find yourself having thoughts about your father-in-law that you wish you could stop thinking about?
No... I wouldn't say that. I mean, he lives with us now, so obviously he's on my mind sometimes, but... it's not like I can't stop thinking about him. Just normal thoughts, really.
Do you feel like you're having any thoughts that you think are unreasonable or excessive?
Um... no. I don't think so. They're just... normal thoughts, I guess. Nothing excessive.
Do you feel like any thoughts are intruding into your mind against your will?
No... not really. I mean, they're just my own thoughts. Nothing is... forcing its way in, if that's what you mean.
Do you have any thoughts that keep repeating in your mind, even when you try to focus on something else?
No. I don't think so. Just... regular thoughts. Nothing like that.
Do you feel like you're having any thoughts that you can't control?
No, not really. I... I feel like I'm in control of them. They're just my thoughts.
Do you feel like there are any thoughts that you're trying to suppress or get rid of, but they keep coming back?
No... nothing like that. I'm not trying to push anything away. They're just normal thoughts.
Do you have any thoughts that you feel are intrusive or unwelcome?
No... I haven't noticed anything like that. It's really just... normal day-to-day stuff. I don't have anything popping into my head like that.
Are there any thoughts that you feel are repeating in your mind even when you try to think of other things?
No. I just... I don't really have that. Like I said, it's just normal thoughts. Nothing repeating or getting stuck.
Do you feel like there are any thoughts that keep coming back to you, even when you try to think about something else?
I... didn't you just ask me that? No. Like I said, I don't have anything like that happening. It's just... regular thoughts.
Do you feel like any thoughts are dominating your thinking to the point where you're having trouble concentrating on other things?
Look... no. I really don't. My thoughts are just my thoughts. I don't know what you're looking for here, but... no. I can concentrate fine. It's nothing like that.
